text:
anya: Quick sync — proposing a three-track Optimize roadmap for next quarter: 1) Runtime recs (batching + KV caching), 2) Quantization profiles & guidance, 3) Eval-triggered alerts. Need concrete launch criteria and pilot asks. Thoughts?
sarah: +1. For customers we should expose per-route batch size suggestions and a "safe quant" toggle. simple UI so PMs can opt-in.
marco: Agree. Need to call out infra deps: telemetry for per-request token counts, queueing metrics, and a hook to adjust batch windows. Example config idea:```json
{"route": "/chat", "target_batch_ms": 15, "max_batch_tokens": 2048, "kv_cache_ttl_secs": 3600}```
marco: Also we should provide a fallback policy that drops to single-request path if p99 spikes.
kevin: Operational risk: adaptive batching can cause tail latency jitter. Launch criterion should include a canary with traffic masks + automatic rollback at 95th percentile regression. :warning:
ashley: Suggest acceptance gates for each track:
- Runtime recs: no >5% p99 latency regression on canary, and error rate delta <=0.1%
- Quant profiles: retrain/regression checks — accuracy regression <1% on golden prompt set
- Eval-alerts: false positive rate <10% and median alert time <2min
anyA: (typo)
anya: nice gates. For pilots we should offer "pilot tier" with longer pid windows and a playbook for engineers to tune settings.
sarah: Customer asks to include cost estimate impact (expected tokens/sec savings and $ delta).
marco: We'll need a telemetry schema (per-route, per-model, per-quant-level): sample rate, avg tokens/request, batch size distribution, model latency buckets. I'll draft.
kevin: Question: do we ship quantization recommendations as "profiles" (fast apply) or as per-customer tuning runs? I prefer profiles + opt-in tuning runs for enterprise.
ashley: Add "regression harness" to the launch checklist: deterministic prompts, golden outputs, and automated diffing + human review flag.
release-bot: Created ticket RN-4852: "Three-track Optimize roadmap: runtime/quant/eval-alerts — spec doc + pilot checklist" assigned to anya, marco.
anya: Action items: 1) marco to draft telemetry schema (due Fri), 2) ashley to write acceptance gates + regression harness plan (due Mon), 3) sarah to collect pilot customer asks and cost-savings requests (due Wed), 4) kevin to define canary/rollback SLOs (due Wed). I'll consolidate into a PR to the roadmap doc after inputs. :rocket:
marco: Sounds good. I'll post the initial schema in this thread when ready.
kevin: If we can, add a small simulation tool to estimate latency vs batch size tradeoffs per model family. Saves a lot of live tuning.
anya: Love that. End-of-thread — will follow up with PR and meeting invite for stakeholding sync.
